0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East) are 1-0 on the road and enter on a one-game losing streak, while the Pacers (2-1, 5th in the East and 1 game back in the Central) are on a one-game winning streak and 0-1 at home. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Joel Embiid, VJ Edgecombe, and Jabari Walker are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle, sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring, strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, including a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
